title: Establish the consumer contract before writing a failing regression
applies_when: A candidate alleges a formatting, validation, shape, resource-budget or backend-support mismatch from a helper name, comment or partial source window, and proposes expected behavior without tracing the producer and consumer.
lesson: Trace production, allocation, transformations and consumption before choosing expected behavior. Distinguish DNS-SD instance labels from hostnames, captured token capacity from request count, and registered kernel geometry from excluded examples in comments. Fabricated inconsistent internal metadata does not establish a reachable defect. Missing validation alone does not establish the proposed invariant. A device-assertion change is not backend support: require a supported caller and checked native outputs. For an allegedly unguarded fallback, intersect its trigger with native launch constraints before allocating a huge reproduction. Seek an observable consumer failure before environment repair or publication.
avoid_when: Reachable malformed inputs, escaping/length violations or supported shape mutations can be real defects. Error wording may have its own documented API contract. Callback stand-ins must preserve backend transformations: RoPE+SDPA may return BHSD from BSHD even when plain SDPA preserves shape. Baseline-fail/patch-pass against an invented callback is insufficient. Static review falsifies a specific claim; it does not prove native or general correctness. External or dynamic callers may remain unobserved.

evidence.note: The small-token guard precedes a fallback requiring >2046 MiB. Ordering alone is not a supported-input failure; combine it with native launch constraints rather than lowering MAX_COMM_SIZE artificially.

16-byte accesses, <=8-block clusters and <=1024 threads bound supported ranks 2/4/8/16 with token_num<=world_size to <=32 MiB, below the fallback threshold. This necessary-domain argument refutes that hang hypothesis, not collective correctness or malformed-input diagnostics.

CLI choices reach argparse; choices.py exposes plugin registration. Enum CUSTOM fallback alone does not prove typo acceptance. Programmatic consumers need separate evidence; not a server or GPU qualification.
RoPE+FP8 SDPA takes BSHD and returns BHSD; its fake implementation permutes accordingly. Plain SDPA differs. A shape-preserving callback misrepresents this backend.
Registered CPU fusion tests use a BHSD-returning RoPE callback matching the backend. Prefer that control; this source does not establish FA3 GPU qualification.
DNS-SD instance labels permit non-control punctuation and are limited to 63 octets; this is a protocol requirement, not a measured application result.
The standard explicitly distinguishes service instance names from hostnames and their naming restrictions.
One normalizer feeds host labels and service instances. A trailing hyphen in the latter alone does not prove an invalid zone; overrides and resolver behavior need separate evidence.
Capture sets metadata_rows=num_tokens; replay derives num_rows from captured sequence_lengths.numel(). This refutes the request-count claim for initialized capture, not GPU correctness.
Device assertions precede Triton launch. CPU/meta rejection-wording tests do not validate another accelerator's cache writes, nor prove that backend unsupported.
The comment excludes B_K=128 variants; registry ids 1400-1404 and 6400-6404 use B_K=64. Asserting their removal does not demonstrate a comment contradiction.

Padded two-slot A/three-slot B formulas give 66-148.5 KiB for registered B_K=64, below 160 KiB; excluded B_K=128 examples give 165/231 KiB. Source arithmetic, not compiled HIP resources or GPU correctness.

The outer wrapper uses sig.bind and applies defaults before passing kwargs to the helper. Its isolated kwargs lookup does not prove a positional/default bug; CUDA and skip_check/auto remain unqualified.

Raw-verify leaves extend_seq_lens=None. Its consumer uses full_like, then torch.minimum creates a new tensor before clamp_min_. Fabricated non-None fields do not prove corruption here; other setters remain unverified and Tensor.to alone need not copy.

The owning constructor always assigns lower_bound. The later getattr/direct read does not prove a missing attribute for this constructor. Inspect the owning class; fabricated objects are not supported-path evidence. Source falsification, not GPU/all-model correctness.
